title: Patsy Cline's Dream Home | Historic Nashville
description:
Sleep inside country music history. This is Patsy Cline's actual Dream Home—the final home she owned, purchased in 1962 at the height of her career. Step back into 1963 in a lovingly preserved Nashville time capsule filled with period details, music and the story of one of country's most legendary voices. Four bedrooms, three full baths and room for up to 10 guests—just 10 miles from downtown Nashville.

The space
This is a classic ranch style home with four bedrooms and three full bathrooms. It has two dining areas, two kitchen areas, and multiple entertaining/hang out areas.
